title: Can you …?
description:
Describe what you can and can’t do; practise requests and large numbers.
描述能做和不能做的事情，练习请求与大数的表达。
answer_note: Workbook and grammar keys were checked against the linked source pages. Suggested answers are labelled. Fill-in answers list missing words in order. Worked examples are excluded from progress. Pronoun alternatives follow the answer key.

lesson.text:
1,000 · a thousand
I can put my hat on, but I can’t put my coat on.
lesson.translation: 我能戴上帽子，但我不能穿上外套。

lesson.text:
5,000 · five thousand
I can see that aeroplane, but I can’t see a bird.
lesson.translation: 我能看见那架飞机，但我看不见鸟。

lesson.text:
10,000 · ten thousand
I can paint this bookcase, but I can’t paint this room.
lesson.translation: 我能漆这个书架，但我不能粉刷这个房间。

lesson.text:
100,000 · a hundred thousand
I can lift that chair, but I can’t lift this table.
lesson.translation: 我能搬起那把椅子，但我不能搬起这张桌子。

lesson.text:
210,000 · two hundred and ten thousand
I can read this book, but I can’t read that magazine.
lesson.translation: 我能读这本书，但我读不懂那本杂志。

lesson.text:
350,000 · three hundred and fifty thousand
I can jump off this box, but I can’t jump off that wall.
lesson.translation: 我能从这个箱子上跳下来，但我不能从那堵墙上跳下来。

lesson.text:
500,000 · five hundred thousand
I can make cakes, but I can’t make biscuits.
lesson.translation: 我会做蛋糕，但我不会做饼干。

lesson.text:
1,000,000 · a million
I can put the vase on this table, but I can’t put it on that shelf.
lesson.translation: 我能把花瓶放在这张桌子上，但我不能把它放在那个架子上。

lesson.title: Written exercise A · Rewrite sentences
lesson.instruction: Rewrite these sentences. Follow the examples.
lesson.translation: 仿照例句改写以下句子。

questions.prompt: He is taking his book.
questions.answer: He can take his book.

questions.prompt: She is putting on her coat.
questions.answer: She can put on her coat.

questions.prompt: They are typing these letters.
questions.answer: They can type these letters.

questions.prompt: She is making the bed.
questions.answer: She can make the bed.

questions.prompt: You are swimming across the river.
questions.answer: You can swim across the river.

questions.prompt: We are coming now.
questions.answer: We can come now.

questions.prompt: We are running across the park.
questions.answer: We can run across the park.

questions.prompt: He is sitting on the grass.
questions.answer: He can sit on the grass.

questions.prompt: I am giving him some chocolate.
questions.answer: I can give him some chocolate.

lesson.title: Written exercise B · Questions and answers
lesson.instruction: Write questions and answers using I, he, she, it, we or they.
lesson.translation: 仿照例句写出相应的对话，选用 I、he、she、it、we 或 they 等代词。

questions.prompt: Can you put on your coat?
questions.answer:
Yes, I can.
What can you do?
I can put on my coat.

questions.prompt: Can you and Sam listen to the radio?
questions.answer:
Yes, we can.
What can you and Sam do?
We can listen to the radio.

questions.prompt: Can you type this letter?
questions.answer:
Yes, I can.
What can you do?
I can type this letter.

questions.prompt: Can Penny wait for the bus?
questions.answer:
Yes, she can.
What can Penny do?
She can wait for the bus.

questions.prompt: Can Penny and Jane wash the dishes?
questions.answer:
Yes, they can.
What can Penny and Jane do?
They can wash the dishes.

questions.prompt: Can George take these flowers to her?
questions.answer:
Yes, he can.
What can George do?
He can take these flowers to her.

questions.prompt: Can the cat drink its milk?
questions.answer:
Yes, it can.
What can the cat do?
It can drink its milk.

questions.prompt: Can you and Sam paint this bookcase?
questions.answer:
Yes, we can.
What can you and Sam do?
We can paint this bookcase.

questions.prompt: Can you see that aeroplane?
questions.answer:
Yes, I can.
What can you do?
I can see that aeroplane.

questions.prompt: Can Jane read this book?
questions.answer:
Yes, she can.
What can Jane do?
She can read this book.

practice.title: A. Can and can’t
practice.translation: 用 can 或 can’t 填空；多空题按顺序填写。

questions.prompt: What _____ you do? – I can lift this box, but I _____ lift that heavy chair.
questions.answer: can; can’t

questions.prompt: What _____ Pamela do? – Well, she _____ type, but she _____ type this letter for the boss. She _____ read his handwriting!
questions.answer: can; can; can’t; can’t

practice.title: B. Questions and answers
practice.instruction: Ask and answer questions like the example. Use can and can’t.
practice.translation: 仿照例句，用 can 或 can’t 提问并回答。

questions.prompt: he / read Chinese? – English
questions.answer:
Can he read Chinese?
No, he can’t read Chinese, but he can read English.

questions.prompt: she / make cakes? – biscuits
questions.answer:
Can she make cakes?
No, she can’t make cakes, but she can make biscuits.

questions.prompt: they / watch television? – listen to the stereo
questions.answer:
Can they watch television?
No, they can’t watch television, but they can listen to the stereo.

questions.prompt: we / eat in the living room? – the kitchen
questions.answer:
Can we eat in the living room?
No, you/we can’t eat in the living room, but you/we can eat in the kitchen.

questions.prompt: I / sweep the floor? – clean the car
questions.answer:
Can I sweep the floor?
No, you can’t sweep the floor, but you can clean the car.

practice.title: C. Situations
practice.instruction: Read the situations. What do you say in each situation, using “Can you …?”
practice.translation: 根据情景用 Can you …? 句式写出你应该说的话。

questions.prompt: You want Anna to type some letters for you.
questions.answer: Anna, can you type these letters for me, please?

questions.prompt: You want Tim to turn on the lights for you.
questions.answer: Tim, can you turn on the lights for me, please?

questions.prompt: You want Bob to make some coffee for you.
questions.answer: Bob, can you make some coffee for me, please?

questions.prompt: You want Penny to give the children these ice creams.
questions.answer: Penny, can you give the children these ice creams, please?

grammar.title: I. Can … but can’t …
grammar.instruction: Make sentences according to the example.
grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=144

questions.prompt: I / speak English / not German
questions.answer: I can speak English but I can’t speak German.

questions.prompt: William / write English / not Chinese
questions.answer: William can write English but he can’t write Chinese.

questions.prompt: Sophie / type / not make tea
questions.answer: Sophie can type but she can’t make tea.

questions.prompt: I / climb up that tree / not jump off it
questions.answer: I can climb up that tree but I can’t jump off it.

questions.prompt: a dog / swim / not climb up a tree
questions.answer: A dog can swim but it can’t climb up a tree.

questions.prompt: she / play basketball / not football
questions.answer: She can play basketball but she can’t play football.

questions.prompt: they / speak Japanese / not write it
questions.answer: They can speak Japanese but they can’t write it.

questions.prompt: he / buy a small house / not a big one
questions.answer: He can buy a small house but he can’t buy a big one.

questions.prompt: you / lift this light box / not that heavy one
questions.answer: You can lift this light box but you can’t lift that heavy one.

questions.prompt: I / read your handwriting / not Bob’s handwriting
questions.answer: I can read your handwriting but I can’t read Bob’s handwriting.

grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=478

grammar.title: II. Full answers
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions in full sentences according to the example.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句，用完整句子回答下列问题。
grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=145

questions.prompt: What language can you speak? (English)
questions.answer: I/We can speak English.

questions.prompt: What language can Ken speak? (French)
questions.answer: Ken can speak French.

questions.prompt: Which box can Mary lift, this one or that one? (this one)
questions.answer: Mary can lift this one.

questions.prompt: Which book can you read, the thick one or the thin one? (the thick one)
questions.answer: I/We can read the thick one.

questions.prompt: What languages can Kathy speak? (Japanese and Korean)
questions.answer: Kathy can speak Japanese and Korean.

questions.prompt: What can you make, bread or cakes? (bread)
questions.answer: I/We can make bread.

questions.prompt: Where can he teach, in a school or in a university? (in a university)
questions.answer: He can teach in a university.

questions.prompt: Which word can you spell, “pen” or “book”? (the two words)
questions.answer: I/We can spell the two words.
